notes: The target is 100 dated discovery items, not 100 publishers or 100 approved relevant articles. Multiple endpoints may belong to one publisher. Secondary sources discover candidates; original evidence and Türkiye/traveler relevance require separate editorial checks. Unknown dates never count as fresh. Source scope exclusions, failures and shortfalls are retained.
